battle.label: Spring and Autumn: Chariot Wars
battle.aria: Spring and Autumn battlefield. The joystick points toward a map direction; the chariot turns smoothly and moves along its facing, then coasts to a stop when released. WASD acts as the joystick and Space fires. On foot, use WASD to move and Space to attack.
battle.pausedCopy: Your forces are standing by. Sound the drums when ready.
battle.defeatCopy: You keep {gold} coins. Retry campaign stage {stage}.
battle.crewFollow: {count} crew follow you · WASD move · Space attack
battle.attack.hint: Tap to fire with aim assist · hold for the full draw

equipment.weaponRack.name: Crossbow Rack
equipment.weaponRack.description: Improves crossbow damage and adds 1 arrow to each volley per upgrade; does not increase chariot collision damage.
equipment.horseArmor.name: Horse Armor
equipment.horseArmor.description: Improves protection, granting a chance to fully negate an incoming ranged attack.
equipment.shaftWheelRim.name: Shaft & Wheel Rim
equipment.shaftWheelRim.description: Improves mobility, speed, and steering; each level also adds 2 collision damage.
equipment.axleCap.name: Axle Cap
equipment.axleCap.description: Improves stability and increases maximum chariot health.
equipment.chariotBox.name: Chariot Box
equipment.chariotBox.description: Capacity is display-only; upgrades add slots for archers and halberdiers.
horse.description: Adds mobility and visible horses. Mobility affects speed and steering, not collision damage.
personnel.archer.name: Archer
personnel.archer.description: Automatically attacks at range; damage is independent of Firepower.
personnel.halberdier.name: Halberdier
personnel.halberdier.description: Automatically attacks in melee; damage is independent of Firepower.
